sources.title: GDPR Art. 22 — automated decisions
sources.why: Automated decisions must be logged and explainable so users can obtain human review and contest the outcome.

sources.title: nFADP Art. 21 & 22 — automated decision + DPIA (Switzerland)
sources.why: Swiss law requires recording and disclosing automated-decision logic, enabling traceability of how each decision was reached.

sources.title: GDPR Art. 35 — Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)
sources.why: A DPIA documents the decision-making pipeline and risk mitigations, providing the traceable record auditors and regulators rely on.
